title: Paddle Pals
description: Two paddles, one cookie, first to 7. Clip it with the edge of your paddle for a nasty angle, grab a donut to make your paddle huge, or hit a chili and turn the cookie into a fireball. Play the CPU or hand a friend the other side of the keyboard.
instructions: Player 1: W and S. Player 2: up and down arrows. Playing solo? Arrows or the mouse work too. On a phone, drag on your half of the screen. P pauses, M mutes.
